axis: 人物の動き(手・顔・歩行)
prompt: A young woman in a beige trench coat walks toward the camera along a rainy Tokyo side street at dusk, holding a clear umbrella. She lowers the umbrella, smiles, and waves with her right hand. Neon signs reflect on the wet pavement. Natural handheld camera, shallow depth of field, photorealistic.

axis: カメラワーク(ドリー・パン)
prompt: Slow cinematic dolly-in through a wooden Japanese tea house toward an open shoji door. Beyond the door, a moss garden with a stone lantern and falling maple leaves. Soft morning light, dust particles in the air, steady camera movement, 35mm film look.

Close-up of hot tea being poured from a cast-iron teapot into a white ceramic cup on a wooden table. Steam rises, the liquid swirls and settles, and a light linen curtain in the background sways in the breeze. Macro lens, realistic fluid motion, soft natural light.

axis: 文字看板(動いても崩れないか)
prompt: A red neon sign reading "OPEN 24H" above a small ramen shop at night flickers on, then a cook in a white uniform steps out through the noren curtain and looks up at it. Camera slowly pans right across the storefront. Rain-soaked street, cinematic lighting.
